about: Open-world performance budget (Physics Dev, 2026-10-27; Strategy's brief: the zone never stutters on a slow phone). PRESENTATION ONLY: nothing here touches the sim or Gate 0. DATA ROWS FOR V3 DEV TO WIRE: no runtime reads this file yet (proposal in docs/proposals/perf-open-world-2026-10-27.md). Per tier, a ceiling for what one frame may cost and the cap of each lever; `ladder` is the order the levers are pulled when the page's frame time stays over `frameMsP95` (same window shape as src/fight/governor.ts: windowFrames samples, overWindows windows in a row; one way only, no step back up, so it never flaps). `corpsesMax` is clamped by data/physics.json corpse.max (the lower wins), `cutPiecesMax` is the live cut-piece meshes kept across all corpses (the oldest corpse's pieces hide first, as pieceSeconds does now), `reactionBlendOff` turns ?feel=hitreact's pose blend off (the impulse and the sim stay), `feelOff` drops the rest of the M7 presentation (clash sparks, limb gait). FIRST PASS: the numbers come from scripts/perf-open-world.mjs on the HF CPU box (receipts in the PR); the cap values are the ones that kept JS-side cost under jsMsBudget there, for Dom and V3 Dev to tune on the iPhone.
